source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The checked subscribe.xhtml change moves subscribe.css before searchBox.css and other shared sheets; the fixed document retains that relative order. The review keeps the general preference to load page-specific CSS after shared rules, while accepting this one-dialog workaround. The author reports the macOS test improves, but the exact overridden rule is unknown and an important trial reportedly did not help. This exception does not reverse the general preference. The selected browser test exercises the search field and filtered rows, without asserting native computed layout. No macOS, pixel or cascade diagnosis was run here.
title: Keep the subscribe stylesheet-order workaround as a scoped exception
